Wyetech, LLC is hiring a Cloud Software Engineer Level 1 to develop and deploy enterprise cloud-based solutions for large-scale compute and data analytics platforms. The role supports secure, scalable cloud-native software through engineering, integration, testing, maintenance, and collaboration within an Agile team.

Responsibilities
Provide cloud software research, development, and engineering support
Support requirements analysis, software development, installation, integration, evaluation, enhancement, sustainment, testing, validation, and issue diagnosis/resolution
Design, develop, integrate, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications supporting large-scale compute and data analytics platforms
Develop secure and reliable software capabilities across cloud infrastructure environments
Support software integration and testing activities, including the development and implementation of test plans and test scripts
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software and cloud-environment issues
Support highly distributed and massively parallel computing environments
Work with Open Source/NoSQL technologies supporting distributed computation, including technologies such as HBase, Accumulo, and Bigtable
Collaborate with developers, Systems Engineers, customers, and other technical stakeholders to meet evolving mission and system requirements
Participate in Agile software-development activities and support continuous integration and deployment practices

Experience with one or more high-level programming languages such as **Java, Python, C, or C++**
Experience working within **Linux-based operating systems**

**Active TS/SCI security clearance with a current polygraph is required.**
**United States Citizenship**
Preferred
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**
Experience with containerization technologies such as **Docker**
Experience with container orchestration technologies such as **Kubernetes**
Experience with **CI/CD tools and DevOps practices**
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies such as **Terraform or Ansible**
Demonstrated experience with Open Source/NoSQL products supporting highly distributed and massively parallel computing, including **HBase, Accumulo, and/or Bigtable**
Experience with **MapReduce, Hadoop, Hive, and/or Pig**
Experience with the **Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)**
Experience supporting **big-data cloud scalability** environments
Experience designing and developing web applications using **JavaScript**
Experience designing and developing automated analytic software, techniques, and algorithms
Experience with compute-cluster monitoring tools
Experience with **Accumulo internals**, including configuring, tuning, and testing Accumulo across large-scale environments exceeding 200 nodes
One or more of the following certifications is desired:
AWS Certified Developer – Associate
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional
Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
Hadoop/Cloud Developer Certification
A bachelor's degree in **Computer Science or a related technical field** is highly desired and may be considered equivalent to two (2) years of experience
Benefits
Wyetech automatically contributes 20% of each employee's gross compensation to a Simplified Employee Pension (SEP) IRA, with no requirement for employee matching. All contributions are fully vested from day one.
Generous PTO plan of up to 200 hours annually, aligned with applicable state leave regulations. Employees have the flexibility to adjust their PTO allocation at the start of each calendar year.
Full-time employees have the option to participate in a variety of voluntary benefit plans.
A choice of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Account (HSA)
Vision and dental
Life and AD&D benefits
Short- and long-term disability
Hospital indemnity, accident, and critical illness insurances
Optional identity theft and legal protection services
Employee referral bonus eligibility up to $10,000
Mobility among Wyetech-supported contracts
Various contract and work locations throughout Maryland, Virginia, Colorado, Texas, Utah, Alaska, Hawaii and OCONUS
Various team-building events throughout the year such as monthly lunches, summer company picnic, and an annual holiday party
Employees receive two complimentary branded clothing orders annually
